read.how: read through the Neon MCP with SELECT statements only, 2026-10-17 11:30-11:43Z. Each bank is the exact string_agg(row_to_json(t)::text, E'\n' ORDER BY <pk>) text Neon returned, and was accepted only after the sha256 computed here equalled encode(sha256(convert_to(txt,'UTF8')),'hex') computed by NEON over the same expression (fixtures/.../bank_from_neon.py holds the shape; it could not be run here because this environment's network policy allows no Postgres connection, only HTTPS through the agent proxy). Nothing was written.

a_slice_not_the_table: These are SLICES, each verbatim and sha-checked, not whole tables: the rows the suite asserts on. The bank moved under this lane while it ran (d091775's five mid-Columbia projects landed 11:22Z and a new Columbia crosswalk 11:27Z), which is why the suite runs on a cut and not on live Neon. Row counts live on Neon at the cut: geo_layer_objects 30, geo_records 70, geo_unit_receipts 44, geo_display_objects 15, geo_display_registry 1.
